channel.title: Los Angeles Times - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Los Angeles Times (latimes.com)

item.title: Coalition rallies to defend Cypress Park day labor center amid disputed Home Depot eviction threat
item.description: A coalition of elected officials, unions and workers rights groups mobilized Friday to defend a day laborer center in Cypress Park as word spread that Home Depot was seeking to evict it, a claim the home improvement store denies.

item.title: Yasiel Puig found guilty in gambling case, faces up to 20 years in prison
item.description: A jury on Friday found former Dodgers outfielder Yasiel Puig guilty of obstruction of justice and making false statements to investigators.

item.title: The Nancy Guthrie ransom note was ‘carefully crafted,’ listed two deadlines, contained key details
item.description: A ransom note demanding money in exchange for the return of 'Today' show host Savannah Guthrie's mother was 'carefully crafted' and included details not previously released to the public about her apparent abduction, according to people who have read it.

item.title: Yes, Trump's video showing the Obamas as apes is racist. But it's also about the election
item.description: The video posted by Trump depicting the Obamas as apes is an escalation in the assault that is likely to come on voting rights in the midterm elections.

item.title: One victim of 99 Ranch Market crash in Westwood identified
item.description: Authorities have released the identity of one victim of the 99 Ranch Market crash that occurred in Westwood Thursday.

item.title: Skier dies on expert run at Mammoth — as horrified witnesses watch from chair lift
item.description: The skier, who has not been identified, was attempting a run called Dropout 2 — among the steepest marked trails in California — which descends from the summit ridge of the 11,000 foot mountain.

item.title: Trump refuses to apologize after sharing racist image of the Obamas: 'I didn't make a mistake'
item.description: The post quickly drew fierce criticism from Democrats, some Republicans and civil rights organizations.

item.title: Italians embrace unity — except with JD Vance — during Olympics opening ceremony
item.description: Italy welcomed the world with a snow-capped spectacle during the opening ceremony of the Milan-Cortina Olympics, pushing past pre-Games tension.

item.title: L.A. public defenders are on a win streak as Trump's Justice Department charges activists
item.description: The federal public defender's office in L.A. was 5 and 0 against prosecutors in trials related to immigration raids and protests. Trial No. 6 was last month.

item.title: County Supervisor Lindsey Horvath won't run for L.A. mayor, ending weeks of speculation
item.description: Bass will still face challenges from reality TV star Spencer Pratt, democratic socialist Rae Huang, entrepreneur Adam Miller and potentially dozens of others.
